description: Comprehensive Android app audit covering UI elements, UX features, performance optimization, and security hardening. userStories.title: Add Android network security configuration for HTTPS enforcement and certificate pinning
userStories.description: As a security engineer, I want the Android app to enforce HTTPS-only connections with certificate pinning for critical domains so that man-in-the-middle attacks are prevented. Currently the Android project has NO network_security_config.xml file, meaning it uses default Android behavior which allows cleartext on older APIs. Create android/app/src/main/res/xml/network_security_config.xml with: (1) cleartextTrafficPermitted=false globally, (2) certificate pinning for build-desk.com and supabase.co domains, (3) debug overrides for local development. Update AndroidManifest.xml to reference the network security config via android:networkSecurityConfig attribute on the <application> tag.

userStories.title: Add comprehensive Android permissions for camera, GPS, biometric, and notifications
userStories.description: As a mobile developer, I want the AndroidManifest.xml to declare all required permissions so that Capacitor plugins for camera, geolocation, push notifications, biometric auth, and offline storage work correctly. Currently only android.permission.INTERNET is declared. The app needs: CAMERA, ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION, ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION, ACCESS_BACKGROUND_LOCATION (with foreground service), VIBRATE, RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED, POST_NOTIFICATIONS (Android 13+), USE_BIOMETRIC, USE_FINGERPRINT, READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE/READ_MEDIA_IMAGES (Android 13+), FOREGROUND_SERVICE, FOREGROUND_SERVICE_LOCATION, ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE, and WAKE_LOCK. Also add uses-feature declarations for camera and location hardware.

userStories.title: Harden AndroidManifest.xml with backup rules, exported controls, and data extraction prevention
userStories.description: As a security engineer, I want the AndroidManifest.xml hardened against data leakage and unauthorized access so that sensitive construction and financial data is protected on Android devices. Currently android:allowBackup=true which exposes app data via ADB backup, and there are no data extraction rules. Changes needed: (1) set android:allowBackup=false to prevent ADB backup of app data, (2) add android:dataExtractionRules for Android 12+ backup control, (3) add android:fullBackupContent=false, (4) set android:usesCleartextTraffic=false explicitly, (5) add android:hardwareAccelerated=true for WebView performance. Create android/app/src/main/res/xml/data_extraction_rules.xml with deny-all rules for cloud and device-to-device transfer.

userStories.notes: COMPLETED. Set allowBackup=false, fullBackupContent=false, usesCleartextTraffic=false, hardwareAccelerated=true, dataExtractionRules=@xml/data_extraction_rules.
